faqs.a:
(a)
Any person violating any applicable provision of this chapter may be punished pursuant
               to
section 1-5
of this Code.
(b)
Each of the following is hereby declared to be a public nuisance, which may be abated
               pursuant to the provisions of article III of
chapter 38
of this Code:
(1)
The conduct of any activity or business prohibited by, or in violation of,
section 53-22
or
section 53-42
of this chapter.
(2)
The distribution, cultivation, dispensing, manufacture, or production of medical marijuana
               by a patient or primary caregiver in any manner that is not in compliance with the
               requirements of article IV hereof, the Colorado Medical Marijuana Code, the Colorado
               Medical Marijuana Program, and any rules or regulations promulgated thereunder; and
(3)
The personal use of non-medical marijuana, including possessing, using, displaying,
               purchasing, transporting, transferring, or consuming marijuana, or possessing, growing,
               processing, or transporting marijuana plants, in any manner that is not in compliance
               with the requirements of article IV hereof, Article XVIII, Section 16 of the Colorado
               Constitution, any applicable state statutes, and any rules or regulations promulgated
               thereunder.
(c)
In addition to any other remedies available to the city, the city may exercise any
               and all remedies available pursuant to the provisions of chapter 10 of part III (Land
               Development Code) of this Code.
(
Ord. No. 4393, § 7(Att. A), 7-1-2013
;
Ord. No. 4436, § 6, 3-17-2014
; Ord. No.
4728
, § 18, 5-18-2020)
